ctgov.note: All Instil/Axion-sponsored studies TERMINATED or WITHDRAWN

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Per 2025 10-K (filed Mar 2026): in January 2026 Instil's wholly owned subsidiary Axion Bio discontinued development of lead candidate AXN-2510 (PD-L1 x VEGF bispecific in-licensed from ImmuneOnco) and terminated the ImmuneOnco license in January 2026. Earlier CoStAR TIL cell-therapy programs were also previously discontinued. Company is now a shell actively seeking to in-license or acquire new therapeutic candidates; no active P1/P2/P3 clinical programs.

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: Program discontinued Jan 2026; ImmuneOnco license terminated
